question: Who is famous for playing the musical instrument shehnai?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Ali Ahmad Hussain**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Ali Ahmad Hussain Khan was a renowned shehnai player.
 
• He passed away on March 16, 2016, in Kolkata, West Bengal.
 
• He was known for his innovative style and mastery over the Indian classical, semi-classical and folk music reportoire.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b974a4cb3820202477c57838a88e1a09224bc14fa613033e581080f14f6d2de0.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Shehnai:

 
- Traditional Indian wind instrument

 - Double reed instrument

 - Often used in North Indian weddings and processions

 - Produces a loud, clear, and penetrating sound

 - Made from wood, with a metal bell at the end

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8c36d7a0c903682a308d5f26d962c38ce830325a0eba673a052f9f89b6e1b882.png]
